ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $3.17 km of unexempted detour at the RydeTAXI metered distance rate ($1.41/km = $4.47) as a Ryde voucher; note that the 3.8 km extra distance is attributable to the driver's unilateral choice of an off-route 7-Eleven, and remind the driver to agree the exact stop with the rider before leaving the shortest route (RD-1 / RD-5).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 17:37–17:50 adding 3.17 km (5.85 km vs 2.68 km optimal). Rider asked only for 'a 7-Eleven on the way' [F9] without naming a location; driver's statement [F11] gives no evidence he disclosed the chosen off-route store before leaving the optimal route, so RD-5 consent does not cover this segment and RD-3(b) denies the stop-request exemption. No traffic incident [F14] and speed bands are 4 [F12][F13], not 1–2, so RD-4 gives no exemption.

rejected_claims.reason: Waiting fee $1.08 is chargeable metered waiting on a RydeTAXI (4 min 10 s stationary, F2); RD-3(c) — waiting time units are not refunded.
Only 3.17 km of the billed 3.8 km excess is an identified unexempted detour; the 0.63 km residual is map-matching residual and is not refunded under RD-2.
Speed band 4 shows ordinary congestion, not the band 1–2 'reasonable cause' corroboration, and bands never exempt alone (RD-4(b)).
Same as F12 — band 4 on the CE is ordinary traffic and does not exempt the deviation.
